title: ENROLL recovery key generated in WebCrypto
description: ENROLL §5.2 generates the recovery key in browser WebCrypto; SPEC §2.4.1 says the recovery key MUST NOT live in a networked device or software keystore. Fix: ENROLL must generate offline (or export to offline storage and erase) per §2.4.1. Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
